dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The tire tracks cross the old bridge. They are fresh, but the rain is already washing them away.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: A neighbor saw a van stop by the river. He heard a phone ring, then the driver turned toward the workshop road.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Victor wants us chasing scraps. We keep gathering evidence, and we do not let the trail split us apart.

police.speaker: David
police.text: Morris stops a delivery driver at the bridge. The driver remembers a van turning toward the workshop.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: Amara matches the van call to a riverside tower. The signal paused near the old bridge.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: I find a broken tail light at the riverbank. Its tracks turn toward the workshop road.
